title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Benchmark
provenance: Reported by flacknabe-cpu (highball-db#515, 2026-10-16), Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, macOS 26.7, Highball 0.10.16, engine x64-crossover26.3-r25, D3DMetal 3 unmodified, HB_TSSHIM_ATOMIC64=1, Metal HUD, 60 fps cap, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 3 of 5 after 8 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Capcom's RE Engine, DirectX 12, so it needs D3DMetal. On M1 and M2 chips D3DMetal says no to the engine's check for 64-bit atomics on descriptor heap resources and the benchmark stops with an unsupported graphics card error. On the Wine 11 engine r25 (Highball 0.10.16) the variable HB_TSSHIM_ATOMIC64=1 makes Highball's DirectX 12 layer answer yes, and the benchmark completes on an M1 Pro: score 11,127 at 1800x1169, 31.9 fps on average, 1 per cent low 15.1, ray tracing off, upscaling off, frame generation off. The recipe sets the engine and the variable.

knownIssues.symptom: Unsupported graphics card error at start on M1 and M2 chips
knownIssues.cause: D3DMetal reports AtomicInt64OnDescriptorHeapResourceSupported as false there, and RE Engine requires it
knownIssues.fix: the recipe: Wine 11 engine r25 or later with HB_TSSHIM_ATOMIC64=1, which has Highball's layer in front of D3DMetal answer yes (confirmed on an M1 Pro, highball-db#515). On an M4 D3DMetal answers yes by itself.
